items: 【U-Shape Stability Structure 】 U-frame trellis is more stable than A-frame trellis. Allowing you to plant a row on both sides. The arch design maximizes the garden space.

【Rustproof Garden Trellis】 Different from conventional metal frames, The stainless steel core has a plastic coating on the exterior. This effectively isolates it from the air, reducing the possibility of oxidation. It also protects the plants from being burned
【Easy to Use 】 Upgrade cross-shaped connector is easier to install than the metal clasp connector. Hassle-free to assemble and disassemble,You can adjust it to the height and length you like.
【Package Detail】Super High Cucumber Trellis X1（47.2x47.2"X21.6"）,Garden clips X20,Leaf Ties X100,Twist Tie X1,Trellis NettingX1，Manual X1.
【Widely Application】Cucumber trellis for the garden provides support for vegetables such as cucumbers, peas, beans, tomatoes, flowers, pumpkin, melon, beans, and other liana crops.
